instruction: Action sports photograph, full shot from a low angle. Inside a judo dojo with yellow mats and blue wall padding, two judokas are engaged in ground grappling. The woman in the blue judogi (R1) is kneeling on the mat with her back to the camera, actively pinning her opponent. The opponent in the white judogi (R2) lies flat on his back, legs raised high in the air as he attempts to defend. The camera captures the intense physical struggle from a side perspective. The lighting is bright and even across the scene, casting soft shadows on the yellow mat.
